method: PRODUCED - CONSUMED symbol parity (rg across src/, bin/, interfaces/, shared/, desktop/). For each pub fn/struct/enum/trait/type/const/static, count files containing the symbol; one-file items are suspicious; one-file items with only test consumers are severed. Cross-checked against dream pipeline (src/memory/dreaming/mod.rs:238-344), rerank dispatch (src/memory/rerank/mod.rs:36-51), bin/aleph-server handlers/memory.rs, builtin_tools/, and thinker/memory_context_provider/constructor.rs to confirm live wires.

findings.produced: EventProjector instance surface (struct + new + rebuild_fact + rebuild_fact_at)
findings.rationale: Only the static fold_events_to_note is called externally (handler.rs:78/269/384/611, migration.rs:266, integration_tests/mod.rs:72). The struct's db field and three instance methods have zero callers. Tests pass the type only as a namespace, never construct it.
findings.proposed_change: Keep fold_events_to_note as pub static (or in a free function). Remove the db field, new(), rebuild_fact(), rebuild_fact_at(); either inline get_memory_events_for_fact/_until at the (currently nonexistent) call sites or delete the helpers.
findings.risk: Low — fold_events_to_note is pub static-eligible (no &self); the only tests using the struct use the static method path.
findings.verification: rg -n "EventProjector::new|\.rebuild_fact\b|\.rebuild_fact_at\b" --type rust returns zero hits. The single non-test hit on EventProjector is the re-export line src/memory/mod.rs:87.

findings.rationale: The full migration module has zero production callers. There is no startup hook, no migration CLI, no admin API. Event-sourced stores replaced the legacy store without ever running this migration. Only the file's own 5 tests exercise the API.
findings.proposed_change: Delete src/memory/events/migration.rs and remove the pub use migration::{EventSourcingMigration, MigrationReport} line from src/memory/mod.rs:84.
findings.risk: Medium — if a future back-fill from pre-event-sourced install is needed, the code must be re-derived. Note this is recoverable from git history; the column-level migration path is already documented at src/memory/store/sqlite/schema/migrations.rs:30.
findings.verification: rg -l "EventSourcingMigration" --type rust returns only src/memory/mod.rs (re-export) and src/memory/events/migration.rs (definition + tests).

findings.rationale: pub builder method with zero callers in the tree. Pure dead surface.
findings.risk: None — builder method, no I/O, no semantic effect.
findings.verification: rg -n "with_embedding" --type rust returns only the definition line.

findings.rationale: pub builder method with only an in-file test caller. Production never sets valid_to directly — only via serde_json deserialisation paths.
findings.proposed_change: Delete the function and its test.
findings.risk: Low — the only other writer of valid_to is the legacy migration path which we are removing in sw-memory-02.
findings.verification: rg -n "close_validity" --type rust returns only the definition and one test.

findings.rationale: The module's own docstring (line 9) explicitly says 'the other RecallAggregate fields are currently unconsumed'. Only the production read paths are recall_signals_last_hit (used by note_decay.rs:130) and co_recall_pairs (used by co_recall_edges.rs:53); neither touches aggregate_for_facts.
findings.proposed_change: Either delete aggregate_for_facts + RecallAggregate + 5 tests, or shrink RecallAggregate to (note_path, signal_count) and demote aggregate_for_facts to private.
findings.risk: Medium — RecallAggregate was designed as the read-side projection; deleting it removes the only pub way to ask 'what notes were recalled this cycle'. note_decay stage currently uses recall_signals_last_hit per-note instead.

findings.rationale: Pure helper used only by the file's own tests. The production WorkflowProposalStage::execute builds its representative chain inline from sorted SQL aggregation; never calls this fn.
findings.proposed_change: Drop aggregate_chains (line 72) and the 2 test call sites at 167 and 179.
findings.verification: rg -n "aggregate_chains" --type rust returns 4 lines, all in the defining file.

findings.risk: None — pure prompt builder, identical signature to other stage prompt builders.
